end.summary:
Practised estimating a large collection using groups as a guide.
Counted 4 groups of 10 and 3 extra objects as 43.
Identified that spreading the same objects in a line does not change the number.
When asked for the number of groups, answered 3; this group-count mix-up was not corrected later.
Teach-back on estimation did not pass.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised using a known group to estimate a larger collection. They used 4 groups of 10 plus 3 extra to reach 43 and noticed that rearranging the same objects does not change the total. There was a mix-up between counting groups and counting objects, and it was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, show small groups of buttons or beans and ask, “How many groups? How many objects altogether?”
